challenge: Esports was a new concept in Pakistan, a niche market rich in traditional culture and religious beliefs, with pandemic limits, weak tournament infrastructure and a limited budget.
actions: Built the esports and community ecosystem and its SOPs with a local production partner. Ran offline qualifiers in 6 cities chosen from user demographic data, KOL programs, event microsites, video production and paid media.
results: Teams grew from 864 (FFPL 3) to 1,152 (FFPL 4); 5,000+ offline participants; 430K+ online reach per season
#2 gaming trending and #25 general trending for the first-ever event in Pakistan
Channels built from scratch: 600K YouTube, 320K Facebook, 80K Instagram
